gloss: square (of a number); square (in area units)

definitions.explanation: Square — used to form units of area (square meters, etc.) and, in mathematics, the square of a number (a number multiplied by itself).

examples.japanese: この{部屋|へや}は{二十|にじゅう}{平方|へいほう}メートルある。
examples.english: This room is twenty square meters.

examples.japanese: {三|さん}の{平方|へいほう}は{九|きゅう}だ。
examples.english: The square of three is nine.

examples.japanese: {土地|とち}の{面積|めんせき}を{平方|へいほう}メートルで{表|あらわ}す。
examples.english: to express the area of land in square meters.

notes:
Used both for area units ({平方|へいほう}メートル = square meter) and for the mathematical square of a number.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {平方|へいほう}メートル: square meter (m²)
- {平方|へいほう}キロメートル: square kilometer
- ~の{平方|へいほう}: the square of ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {立方|りっぽう}: cube; cubic — the three-dimensional counterpart ({立方|りっぽう}メートル = cubic meter)
- {二乗|じじょう}: squaring; the second power — the math operation of raising to the power of two
